plainText:
Youssef (Japanese: ヒロノブ Hironobu) is a minor non-player character in . He is a student at Naranja Academy /Uva Academy . He is close companions with Atticus, whom he respectfully refers to as Don Atticus (Japanese: シュウメイ殿 Shūmei-dono)

==In the core series games==
Youssef is first encountered outside the entrance of Navi Squad's Base, where he battles the to try and stop them from raiding it. After Atticus is defeated by the player, Youssef helps him come to terms with his loss by reminding him of their friendship.

During the post-game, Youssef makes a brief appearance during Atticus's section of Penny's bond story. At the school store in Naranja Academy /Uva Academy , Atticus is infuriated to learn that another student had purchased a pair of ninja costumes he was intending to buy. He is calmed down by Youssef, who reveals that he was the one who bought the costumes. Afterward, the two leave to play make-believe ninja together.

===Pokémon===
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Navi Squad's Base
Outside, before battle
"I don't care! I'm not leaving till you let me talk to Don Atticus!"
"Huh?"
"Hold on, Mr. Grunt. I think this boy/girl might be !"
Regardless of choice: "I knew it!"
"Leave him/her to me, Mr. Grunt! I‘ll buy some time for you to go wake up the others!"
"Don Atticus will be in danger if no one's here to defend the base!"
"I owe that man my life! He's my dear compadre!"
"And when crisis calls, one has no choice but to rally to those dear to him—no matter the cost!"
"All right, you villain! If you're after Don Atticus, be prepared to face my wrath!""
Bring it on: "YAAAAAAH!"
Wait a sec: "Discretion is the better part of valor, as the saying goes. Wise choice!"

Upon being defeated
"I talk big, but I'm no warrior..."

After being defeated
"Don Atticus...I'm sorry I failed you..."
"Argh... No fair! You had backup this whole time!"
"You're right—I'm not a member of Team Star... but Don Atticus is my compadre!"
"I have to see him no matter what!"

Inside, after Atticus is defeated
"Don Atticus!"
"Don Atticus, please, hear what I have to say! I only need a moment!"
"I came to help you!"
"If you don't start going to class again, you'll be expelled from the academy, right?"
"When the other kids at school and I were getting bullied real bad, you and the rest of Team Star saved us!"
"Thanks to that operation you carried out, we were all able to go to school again!"
"If you got expelled for being the good guys, that'd be the worst thing ever!"
"Haven't you heard anything from the big boss...?"
"That's awful..."
"So that's why you don't go to school..."
"But...but still! Don't ever think that Team Star is all you have, Don Atticus!"
"You've got a lifelong compadre in me—and don't you forget it!"

Naranja /Uva Academy
In the school store
"Oh, Don Atticus! Here you are!"
"Oh yeah, I got us covered! I already bought to sets of that ninja cosplay stuff for us to wear!"
"When I came here earlier, the shopkeeper lady was putting them out on the shelves."
"You know how popular these outfits are... I was super lucky to be able to snag 'em!"
"Now c'mon! Let's go play ninja outside!"
"Ooooooh! Awesome!"
"Ummm... I'm good, thanks."

===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
Youssef debuted in PASV20. At Tagtree Thicket, he saw Clavell disguised as a student named Clive and assumed he was trying to raid the Navi Squad's Base. Youssef launched a sneak attack, but was easily fended off. Admitting defeat, Youssef explained he wasn't a Team Star member, but was close friends with Atticus, the Navi Squad boss. To his shock, Clavell revealed that he learned about an internal conflict within Team Star. Several Grunts planned to launch a coup, defeat the remaining bosses, and reform Team Star to suit their benefits. Clavell assured Youssef he meant Team Star no harm and asked that he cooperate with him. 

In PASV22, after Clavell was taken into the base, Youssef learned that the raid had already started and ran off to where Atticus was. He and Clavell found Atticus in battle with , who had disguised herself as . Despite having her vision severely impaired by one of Atticus's ninja techniques, Scarlet eventually won the battle. Accepting his defeat, Atticus stepped down as squad boss and healed Scarlet, only for her to harshly criticize his cruel actions in their battle, stating they made him no better than the bullies that led to Team Star's formation in the first place. While Scarlet and left, Clavell stayed behind to discuss Team Star-related matters with Youssef and the others.

In PASV24, Youssef questioned Scarlet's harsh words towards Atticus, noting that deceitful tactics are normal when defending oneself. Atticus stated that Scarlet was in the right and revealed that she never issued a formal raid challenge. He admitted that his behavior during their battle was due to being angered when Scarlet made fun of his ninja hobby and apologized to his subordinates for how he acted.

==In the TCG==
 
 
Youssef made an appearance on the version of the Clive card illustrated by Taiga Kayama.
